name: Hilton Honors Credit Cards

apr.notes: Variable APR based on creditworthiness and the Prime Rate. Cash advance APR 28.74%. Penalty APR 29.99%. Accurate as of 07/24/26.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees from American Express.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated; Amex generally requires good to excellent credit.

categories.label: Flights booked directly with airlines or AmexTravel.com, and car rentals
U.S. restaurants, including takeout and delivery

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeemable for reward nights, car rentals, shopping, and exclusive experiences through Hilton Honors.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 175,000 Hilton Honors Bonus Points after spending $6,000 in first 6 months. Offer ends 07/29/2026.

benefits.title: Hilton Honors Diamond Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Diamond status. 100% Bonus on Base Points per stay, Premium Wi-Fi, space-available room upgrades, executive lounge access at select properties.

benefits.title: $400 Hilton Resort Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 in statement credits semi-annually (Jan-Jun and Jul-Dec), up to $400/year, on eligible purchases at participating Hilton Resorts charged to room and paid with Aspire Card.

benefits.title: Annual Free Night Reward
benefits.description: One Free Night Reward from Hilton Honors in first year and every year upon Card renewal. Redeemable for one standard accommodation. Expires one year from issuance.

benefits.title: Spend-Based Free Night Rewards
benefits.description: Earn a Free Night Reward after $30,000 spend in a calendar year, and another after $60,000 total spend in that year.

benefits.title: $200 Flight Credit
benefits.description: Up to $50 in statement credits each calendar quarter, up to $200/year, on eligible airfare purchases made directly with an airline or through AmexTravel.com.

benefits.title: $219 CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.description: Up to $219 in statement credits per calendar year for CLEAR+ Membership paid with the Aspire Card. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $100 Property Credit at Waldorf Astoria & Conrad
benefits.description: Up to $100 property credit per booking for 2-night minimum stays at Waldorf Astoria and Conrad Hotels when booked through HiltonHonorsAspireCard.com.

benefits.title: National Car Rental Emerald Club Executive Status
benefits.description: Complimentary National Car Rental Emerald Club Executive status with Executive Area Access for full-size reservations and above in USA and Canada.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees from American Express.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of rental vehicle. Not available in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand.

benefits.title: Premium Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 medical, legal, financial, and emergency coordination when traveling more than 100 miles from home. Emergency medical transportation may be provided at no cost if approved.

benefits.title: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen baggage. Up to $3,000 combined for checked and carry-on baggage.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: If round-trip paid with Card and covered reason delays trip more than 6 hours, reimburses up to $500 per trip, max 2 claims per 12 months.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses non-refundable expenses up to $10,000 per trip and $20,000 per 12 months for covered cancellations or interruptions.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Protects covered purchases against accidental damage or theft for up to 90 days.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Extends Original Manufacturer's Warranty for up to one additional year on covered purchases.
